text: You see a scout for the Nightkin.
source_text: You see a scout for the Nightkin.

text: 你看见一个夜行团侦察兵。
source_text: 你看见一个夜行团侦察兵。

text: What have we here? A normal. I think you will come with me.
source_text: What have we here? A normal. I think you will come with me.

text: 看看这是谁啊？一个正常人那。我相信你会跟我走的。
source_text: 看看这是谁啊？一个正常人那。我相信你会跟我走的。

text: It is really quite simple. If you come with me, I can help you.
source_text: It is really quite simple. If you come with me, I can help you.

text: 真的很简单。如果你和我走，我能帮助你。
source_text: 真的很简单。如果你和我走，我能帮助你。

text: Ok. I will go with you.
source_text: Ok. I will go with you.

text: Just point me to the leader instead.
source_text: Just point me to the leader instead.

text: With the quickest of haste. Look for Uthern. He will set you straight.
source_text: With the quickest of haste. Look for Uthern. He will set you straight.

text: 万分紧急。找找尤瑟。他会带你去的。
source_text: 万分紧急。找找尤瑟。他会带你去的。

text: Uthern wants to see you. Seems he's heard of you.
source_text: Uthern wants to see you. Seems he's heard of you.

text: 尤瑟想见你。看来他已经听说你了。
